subject: E-3122: token rejected on Windows
body:
Good morning. My setup is MeshMail 2.8.0, Windows 11 23H2.
Whenever I log in since last week, the app shows 'E-3122:
authentication token rejected'.

This month the organisation moved everyone to single sign-
on. I can log in through the browser; only the app refuses.

I've already tried restarting the machine, which changed
nothing.

Regards, Priya Nair, Oakline Partners
